name: May
subtitle: Customer Relationship Management
gameMetaphor: In Snake & Ladders, every ladder rockets you forward and every snake drags you down. CRM is the same game — a personalized follow-up is a ladder that climbs toward loyalty, while a missed interaction or poor experience is a snake that drops the client back to square one. Master the board, know where the snakes hide, and always aim for the ladders.
description: Understanding the complete customer journey from first interaction to long-term loyalty. Learn to leverage CRM tools effectively, track client preferences, and create personalized experiences that turn visitors into brand advocates within Soho Group.
keyPoints: CRM platform navigation and data entry best practices
Client profiling and segmentation strategies for luxury retail
Building and maintaining effective loyalty programs
Personalized follow-up communication techniques
Measuring customer lifetime value and retention metrics

name: June
subtitle: Master Your Minutes
theme: Beat the Clock — Every Second Counts
gameMetaphor: Time management is a race track — you have laps to complete (daily tasks), pit stops for refueling (breaks), and a finish line to cross each day. The wrong strategy and you spin out or run out of fuel. The right one — proper pacing, smart pit stops, and knowing when to accelerate — and you set a personal best every single day.
description: Develop strategies to prioritize tasks, eliminate time-wasters, and create systems that allow you to focus on high-impact activities. Learn the art of pacing your day like a champion racer.
keyPoints: Conducting a personal time audit and identifying time leaks
The Eisenhower Matrix for priority decision-making
Techniques for managing distractions and deep focus
Effective delegation without micromanaging
Creating daily and weekly planning systems

name: July
subtitle: Structure for Success
theme: Know the Rules, Play the Game
gameMetaphor: Every board game has a clear board, defined rules, organized pieces, and a turn order. Organization skill is exactly the same — your workspace is the board, your processes are the rules, your documents are the pieces, and your workflow is the turn order. When everything is in its place and everyone knows the rules, the game flows perfectly.
description: Build frameworks for organizing workflows, digital assets, physical spaces, and team processes. A well-organized professional delivers consistent excellence through structured systems.
keyPoints: Digital workspace organization and file management
Workflow optimization and process mapping
Team process documentation and standardization
Physical space organization for retail environments
Creating repeatable systems for consistency

name: August
subtitle: Measuring What Matters
theme: Follow the Clues to Unlock Business Growth
gameMetaphor: KPIs are like a treasure hunt — each metric is a clue that leads you closer to the prize of business growth. You need the right map (your dashboard), the right clues (data points like conversion rate, ATV, UPT), and the right instincts to interpret them. Some clues are red herrings — vanity metrics that don't move the needle. Follow the real clues and unlock the treasure.
description: Understand the key performance indicators that drive retail success. Learn to read, interpret, and act on business data to make informed decisions that impact the bottom line.
keyPoints: Understanding core retail KPIs (conversion, ATV, UPT, footfall)
Reading and interpreting sales reports and dashboards
Setting realistic targets and tracking progress
Identifying vanity metrics vs. actionable data
Presenting business performance to stakeholders

name: September
subtitle: Elevating Together
gameMetaphor: Like a sports training camp where athletes push their limits together, build trust through shared drills, and sharpen every muscle — team performance training is a fitness camp for your professional skills. Every drill builds a stronger team, every coaching session refines technique, and every challenge test builds the endurance needed to perform under pressure.
description: Explore techniques for motivating teams, setting clear expectations, providing constructive feedback, and creating an environment where everyone performs at their best.
keyPoints: Understanding team dynamics and personality types
Setting clear expectations and accountability frameworks
The art of constructive feedback and coaching
Motivation techniques beyond monetary incentives
Conflict resolution and difficult conversations

name: October
subtitle: Operational Excellence
theme: Haunted Learning — Navigate the Dark Corridors of Operations
gameMetaphor: Store operations is like exploring a haunted house — every room hides a different challenge. The stockroom could be a maze of shadows, the sales floor could have puzzles hidden in plain sight, and compliance lurks in the darkest corners waiting to catch you off guard. Only those who face each room with courage, follow the rules, and master the unknown make it out with operational excellence.
description: Master the daily operations that keep a luxury retail store running seamlessly — from inventory management and visual merchandising to loss prevention and compliance.
keyPoints: Daily operations: opening rituals and closing ceremonies
Inventory management: surviving the stockroom maze
Visual merchandising: bringing the displays to life
Loss prevention: watching the shadows
Health, safety & compliance: the rules of the haunted house

sessions.title: Entering the House — Opening & Closing Rituals

name: November
subtitle: The Art of Styling
theme: Solve the Puzzle, Unlock the Look
gameMetaphor: An escape room is a series of interconnected puzzles you must solve under pressure to unlock the door. Styling a client is the same challenge — read the clues (body language, personal style cues), crack the code (understand their preferences), piece together the solution (curate the perfect outfit), and unlock the door to the perfect look.
description: Develop your eye for styling, learn to read client cues, and master the art of personalized recommendations. Each client is a new room — solve the puzzle and unlock their perfect look.
keyPoints: Reading client clues: body language and style signals
Cracking the code: understanding preferences quickly
Curating complete looks and cross-category styling
Personalization techniques for VIP clients
Working under pressure: styling consultations

sessions.title: Reading the Room — Client Style Clues

name: December
subtitle: Speak with Impact
theme: The Advent Calendar — Unwrap a New Skill Each Week
gameMetaphor: Like an advent calendar hides a surprise behind every door, this month reveals a new communication skill each week. Open Door 1 and discover the power of precise words. Open Door 2 and unlock the secrets of body language. Open Door 3 and master the art of storytelling. By the final door, you'll have unwrapped the complete gift of communication excellence.
description: Refine your verbal and non-verbal communication skills. Each session is a new "door" to open — revealing techniques that transform how you connect, persuade, and present in luxury retail.
keyPoints: Door 1: Verbal mastery — choosing words that open doors
Door 2: Non-verbal magic — body language and presence
Door 3: Active listening — hearing what isn't said
Handling objections with grace and confidence
Storytelling that captivates and convinces
